name: AXM Workshop Search & Provenance Index
actions: search Workshop source and project files
inspect file, pack and syntax provenance
summary: Search Workshop source, tools, projects, docs, asset metadata and structured code-recipe references with hashes, paths, review holds and explicit private-area exclusions.
notes: State, logs, backups, exports, bridge material and secret-like names are excluded. Recipe snippets never execute, and held recipe code is excluded from the searchable projection. Indexing never changes source files.
